verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gazebo's simulator source is in a public GitHub repository (gazebosim/gz-sim), and the docs say developers build custom plugins and use the individual libraries directly, so the source is readable. Nothing in the pack states which license covers that code, so the 'open license' half of the story is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement (e.g. a LICENSE file or license name) for gz-sim and the related libraries, and independent corroboration of the licensing terms.
